headline: Swelect Energy Systems Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - SWELECT Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 100% (one hundred percent) equity shares of SUSHMA SOLAR ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED, a Company based in Rajasthan.
